verdict.rationale: Ironclad has no CLI or CI tooling, but it can be driven headlessly through its REST API. The API supports non-interactive machine authentication via the OAuth Client Credentials Grant, programmatic and bulk workflow launches, records CRUD, export jobs, and API-managed webhooks. However, workflows must first be designed and published by a human in Workflow Designer, and API access requires a paid add-on. missing for 10: an official CLI or CI integration (e.g. GitHub Actions or pipeline docs), fully code-based workflow and template definition without the UI, a published OpenAPI spec (probe returned 404), and independent hands-on corroboration of headless or CI use.
